This bill is part of a package that would let the minister expand trade support loans to apprentices in sectors like aged care, disability care and childcare.
The bill would replace the current priority list with a new one the minister sets based on advice from Jobs and Skills Australia.
The bill would also let the secretary give apprentices more time to apply for a loan payment instalment.
The bill would end the current TSL Priority List.
The bill would let the minister make a new Australian Apprenticeships Priority List by legislative instrument after considering advice from Jobs and Skills Australia.
The bill would expand qualifying apprenticeships to include occupations on the new list, opening loans to people in other ANZSCO groups.
The bill would let the secretary delay the deadline for applying for a loan instalment.
Apprentices and trainees in sectors experiencing skills shortages, such as aged care, disability care and childcare.
